bio: The name of this tapas and wine bar is a subtle phonetic tribute to Francesc Cambó, founder of the historic building in which it is located. The menu here features tapas and dishes to share, all of which showcase the quality of ingredients and local cuisine, all accompanied by pairings from the extensive and carefully curated wine cellar of over 150 labels. The overall look here is one characterised by elegant Mediterranean-style decor, with decorative detail inspired by Catalan Modernism, large windows that flood the space with natural light, and a cosy atmosphere that provides an enjoyable backdrop....
